summary.name: Itsycal
summary.one_liner: Itsycal is a tiny menu bar calendar for Mac that shows Calendar app events, ISO week numbers, and a configurable clock.
use_cases: View calendar events from the Mac menu bar
Show ISO week numbers in a calendar
Join virtual meetings from calendar events
Replace the macOS system clock with a custom date and time
Navigate a calendar with keyboard shortcuts
summary.what_it_does: Itsycal is a small calendar that lives in the Mac menu bar. It integrates with the Mac Calendar app to create and display events, and it can join virtual meetings from them. It shows ISO week numbers and can display up to two months at a time, with multiple font sizes and Dark Mode. Keyboard controls include Vim-style motions, jumping to a specific date, a configurable shortcut to open it, and a URL scheme. It can also replace the system clock and sounds a discrete hourly beep.
notable: Integrates with the Mac Calendar app and can join virtual meetings
Vim motions with optional repeat count and URL scheme for automation
Configurable system clock replacement with ISO week numbers
Open source on GitHub (sfsam/itsycal), listed as freeware
caveats: Requires macOS 11 or later; a separate download is offered for macOS 27+
